title: yandex-office agent config
description: Local runtime configuration for one agent/data directory. This file lives at {data_dir}/config.agent.json and stores local preferences and overrides only; account inventory and OAuth tokens are managed by the auth runtime.

mail.description: Local Mail runtime settings, including named filters, throttling, output spill behavior, and state file naming.

filters.description: Named Mail filters keyed by lowercase English schema keys. Keys are used for persistent state and incoming subdirectory names; default is reserved for ad-hoc runs.

sender.description: (DEPRECATED) see mail.filters.<name>. Legacy top-level FROM criterion upgraded in memory into mail.filters.telemost.sender.

subject.description: (DEPRECATED) see mail.filters.<name>. Legacy top-level SUBJECT criterion upgraded in memory into the Telemost filter.

since_date.description: (DEPRECATED) see mail.filters.<name>. Legacy top-level lower date bound for Mail search, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

before_date.description: (DEPRECATED) see mail.filters.<name>. Legacy top-level upper date bound for Mail search, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

^(?!default$|sender$|subject$|since_date.description: One named Mail filter. The key must be a lowercase English schema key used for state and incoming directory names.

sender.description: Literal IMAP FROM substring criterion for this named filter.

subject.description: Literal IMAP SUBJECT substring criterion for this named filter.

since_date.description: Lower date bound for this named filter, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

before_date.description: Upper date bound for this named filter, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

enabled.description: Whether this named filter participates in bare fetch runs; --filter can still run disabled filters explicitly.

any.description: OR-style list of atomic Mail query branches for one logical filter. Each branch has current AND semantics, and persistent cursor state is tracked per branch.

items.description: One atomic Mail query branch inside an OR-style logical filter.

sender.description: Literal IMAP FROM substring criterion for this query branch.

subject.description: Literal IMAP SUBJECT substring criterion for this query branch.

since_date.description: Lower date bound for this query branch, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

before_date.description: Upper date bound for this query branch, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

sleep_seconds.description: Pause between real Mail message processing iterations, in seconds. Dry-run search-only queries do not use this delay.

output.description: Mail output handling for broad dry-run result sets.

max_inline_symbols.description: Maximum inline output size measured in symbols/characters before Mail writes a spill file.

spill_dir.description: Directory name under {data_dir} where oversized dry-run Mail output is written.

since.description: Whether Mail uses state-driven IMAP SINCE filtering for large accounts.

state_file.description: Mail state file name under {data_dir}; tracks UID/date cursors by account and filter.

calendar.description: Local Calendar settings for event creation and future availability workflows. Calendar event creation needs one effective time context from CLI or this local config. If both timezone and utc_offset are present here, they must represent the same UTC offset at the event start. Time preference belongs here, not in config.skill.json.

default_calendar.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Preferred Yandex Calendar name when a command does not specify one.

business_hours.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Preferred local business-hours window for availability helpers.

start.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Business day start time in HH:MM local wall-clock format.

end.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Business day end time in HH:MM local wall-clock format.

slot_granularity_minutes.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Preferred availability slot size in minutes.

timezone.description: IANA timezone default for Calendar event creation, such as Europe/Moscow. Use this or calendar.utc_offset in local config.agent.json, not config.skill.json; CLI --timezone overrides it for one command.

utc_offset.description: Fixed UTC offset default for Calendar event creation: Z, +HH:MM, or -HH:MM. Use this or calendar.timezone in local config.agent.json, not config.skill.json; CLI --utc-offset overrides it for one command.

contacts.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Local Contacts settings.

default_addressbook.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Preferred address book name for Contacts commands.

sync_on_startup.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Whether Contacts workflows should refresh local data at startup when supported.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Contacts cache time-to-live in seconds.

fuzzy_match_threshold.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Minimum fuzzy-match score for contact name matching.

directory.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Local Directory lookup settings.

cache_ttl_hours.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Directory cache time-to-live in hours.

default_per_page.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Default Yandex 360 Directory page size for list operations.

search_fuzzy_threshold.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Minimum fuzzy-match score for Directory search matching.

forms.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Local Forms export and polling settings.

state_file.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Forms state file name under {data_dir}.

default_format.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Default response export format for Forms commands.

export.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Forms export polling settings.

poll_interval_seconds.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Seconds between Forms export polling attempts.

max_wait_seconds.description: (RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE) Maximum seconds to wait for a Forms export to become ready.

oauth_apps.description: Agent-local custom OAuth app catalog entries discovered or added for this data directory.

catalog.description: Custom OAuth apps keyed by local app id.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes granted by this app.

name.description: Display name persisted for automatically discovered custom apps.

app_name.description: Display name used by configured app catalog entries.

service.description: Service or services this app is intended to cover.

is_default.description: Whether this local app is the default app for its service.

omit_scope_in_url.description: Whether OAuth setup should omit the scope query parameter for this app.
